entities.summary: Takanori Jinnai (b. 1958-08-12, Ōkawa-shi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ōkawa-shi and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
